biotools.summary: CASYMIR is an open-source Python package for modeling direct and indirect-conversion x-ray imaging detectors under various acquisition conditions. It allows the computation of Modulation Transfer Function (MTF) and Noise Power Spectrum (NPS) and has been validated against commercial x-ray detectors.
